title: Asymptotic Normality and Convergence Rates for Tsallis Entropy Estimators via Stabilization Techniques
summary: We study nearest-neighbor-based estimators of Tsallis entropy associated with Poisson and binomial point processes on general metric measure spaces. Using stabilization techniques based on flexible add-one cost operators together with second-order Poincaré inequalities, we establish asymptotic normality and derive explicit convergence rates for the Kolmogorov distance. Our analysis avoids explicit score-function decompositions and instead relies on flexible localizations of add-one costs, which simplify the treatment of higher-order terms.
